derived: 2026-07-30, manoeuvre gate wired into the strict protocol
why: evidence/ratop_edge_jump.json measured that the envelope gate cannot fail the RA-top go-around (go-around stays 43-63 u from each route's cloud vs bands of 47.8-110.7 u, quad_to_ra has no band); the fix is a manoeuvre requirement per RA-top route

where.gate: pipeline/ratop_gate.py — MANOEUVRE_GATES anchors + check(route, pos, ground, speed)
where.wiring: pipeline/strict_eval.py — run() keeps a per-tick ground flag in each trace (column 4), checks every ARRIVED episode of a gated route with ratop_gate.check(), and reports per-approach manoeuvre_rate / manoeuvre_gate / manoeuvre_worst_u; evaluate() adds route-level manoeuvre_gated / manoeuvre_rate_min / manoeuvre_gate and passes_strict now requires manoeuvre_gate (any arrived episode that skipped the jump fails the route)

spec.logic: one airborne event, same spirit as pipeline/manoeuvres.py executed(): takeoff within tol_u of the human takeoff AND next ground contact within tol_u of the human landing, plus void_u >= min_void_u under the flight (record_replay.air_segments' floor probe, run on candidate segments only); demo-derived ground flags get single-tick apex blips (vz==0 at a jump's apex) cleared before segmentation — apex is a local z maximum where a real bunny-hop touch is a minimum, so bot traces are unaffected
spec.aggregation: manoeuvre_rate = fraction of arrived episodes that executed the jump; route fails strict if any approach has an arrived episode that skipped it
spec.anchor_source: human_jump fields of evidence/ratop_edge_jump.json, embedded as literals in pipeline/ratop_gate.py

reference_demo_ring_to_ratop.note: errors are 0 because the anchors were derived from this demo; the margin the tolerance leaves is the full 96 u

test_results_2026_07_30.quad_to_ra: no owner reference demo exists (record_reference.py audit note); anchors from the evidence file, corpus means sit within tolerance

synthetic_go_around.trace: probed floor route from the evidence file: ledge z312 -> z264 walkway east -> ramp x~316 -> west along RA ledge, 137 ticks, ends 27.9 u from the landing anchor standing on it
synthetic_go_around.note: fails on the one-event check: the drop off the ledge starts at the takeoff anchor but lands 140.5 u from the landing anchor (tol 96); walking onto the landing spot afterwards does not count
